career_ladder.note: Forest Beat Officers (FBO) and Forest Section Officers (FSO) are the frontline uniformed protective cadre of the Telangana Forest Department, responsible for boundary patrol, anti-poaching, reserve forest protection, and wildlife preservation. Promotions are governed by the Telangana Forest Subordinate Service Rules (TFSSR) and the Telangana Forest Service Rules.

exam_scheme.note: The Forest Beat Officer (FBO) and Forest Section Officer (FSO) selection process comprises three successive stages: (1) Written Examination (Objective Type CBRT/OMR) carrying 200 marks; (2) Physical Walking Test (qualifying nature: 25 km in 4 hours for men, 16 km in 4 hours for women); and (3) Physical Measurement and Medical Examination. NCC certificate holders receive bonus marks (NCC-C: 5 marks, NCC-B: 3 marks, NCC-A: 1 mark) added to written test marks. Minimum qualifying marks for written test are: OC: 40%, BCs: 35%, SCs/STs: 30%.

stages.source_label: TSPSC Notification No. 48/2017 Annexure-III (Scheme & Syllabus for FBO)

papers.negative_marking: No negative marking (1 mark per question across 100 objective multiple-choice questions)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Merit paper; evaluated with Paper-II; minimum qualifying marks in aggregate are 40% for OC, 35% for BC, 30% for SC/ST

papers.paper_name: Paper II: General Mathematics (SSC Standard - Arithmetic & Algebra)
papers.negative_marking: No negative marking (1 mark per question across 100 objective multiple-choice questions)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Merit paper; evaluated with Paper-I; minimum qualifying marks in aggregate are 40% for OC, 35% for BC, 30% for SC/ST

stages.source_label: TSPSC Notification No. 48/2017 Para I(4) & Para VIII (Procedure of Selection)

papers.paper_name: Walking Test (Men: 25 km in 4 hours; Women: 16 km in 4 hours)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Mandatory endurance qualification test; candidates must complete the designated distance within the 4-hour time limit without running assistance

stages.source_label: TSPSC Notification No. 48/2017 Para I(4) (Physical Requirements & Eye Sight)

papers.paper_name: Physical Standards Verification & Medical Board Assessment
papers.qualifying_threshold: Male: Height not less than 163 cm (158 cm for ST), Chest 84 cm with 5 cm expansion; Female: Height not less than 150 cm (145 cm for ST), Chest 79 cm with 5 cm expansion; Normal eye sight certified by Civil Assistant Surgeon

financial_package.note: Forest Beat Officers in the Telangana Forest Department are compensated under the Telangana Revised Pay Scales 2020 (RPS 2020), notified vide G.O.Ms.No.51, Finance (HRM.IV) Department, dated 11/06/2021. The post is placed in Scale 5 (₹22,900 – 69,150; revised from pre-2020 scale ₹16,400 – 49,870) with an Entry Basic Pay of ₹22,900. (Forest Section Officers start in Scale 11, ₹31,040 – 92,050, entry basic pay ₹31,040). Allowances include 58% project constant DA, HRA (11% to 24%), uniform maintenance allowance, and field hardship rations.
financial_package.pay_source_label: TSPSC Notification No. 48/2017 Para I(3) & G.O.Ms.No.51 Finance (HRM.IV) Dept Dt.11/06/2021
financial_package.estimate_note: Gross pay calculated on entry basic pay of ₹22,900 with 58% DA (₹13,282), HRA ranging from 11% (₹2,519 in interior beat/range stations) to 24% (₹5,496 in urban division headquarters), plus uniform allowance and field duty allowance (~₹1,500–₹2,500). In-hand reflects standard deductions: 10% NPS employee contribution on Basic+DA (₹3,618), Professional Tax (₹200), and TSGLI/EHS insurance deductions (~₹600).
official_perks: Uniform and kit maintenance allowance for field protective forestry operations
Special compensatory allowance for postings in dense forest ranges and tiger reserves (Amrabad, Kawal)
Free government quarters / forest beat housing or HRA in lieu thereof
Employee Health Scheme (EHS) cashless medical treatment for staff and family members
Telangana State Government Life Insurance (TSGLI) and Group Insurance Scheme (GIS) coverage
NPS pension benefits with 14% matching employer contribution
